title: Travis CI API token: one-property twin (context) (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]
summary: 8 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: TRAVIS_API_TOKEN renamed TRAVIS_JOB_NUMBER, a Travis identifier name; the token is kept byte-for-byte, context: TRAVIS_API_TOKEN renamed TRAVIS_REPO_SLUG, a Travis identifier name; the token is kept byte-for-byte, and context: the Travis API host replaced by a neutral one, so no travis keyword remains on the line; the token is kept byte-for-byte, and 5 more. Twin of "Travis CI API token: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of travisci-api-token-context-base-1: context: TRAVIS_API_TOKEN renamed TRAVIS_REPO_SLUG, a Travis identifier name; the token is kept byte-for-byte. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
